name: Jacqueline Munoz
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Jacqueline is a senior clinical psychologist based in Parkville, Victoria, with over a decade experience in psychological assessment, treatment, clinical supervision, and professional consultation services. She offers appointments to young people, adults, parents, and families struggling with complex mental health difficulties. She has expertise in providing evidence-based treatment for people suffering from emotional dysregulation, Complex Post Traumatic Stress Disorder and eating disorders.
specialties: Diverse genders, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Schema Therapy

name: Haley Kirk
title: Contact Psychologist
description: I enjoy working with a range of issues such as relationship difficulties, complex family dynamics, struggles with self worth/ confidence and chronic depression and anxiety. People I work with often struggle with understanding why they feel the way they feel and find it difficult to shift particular internal narratives that keep them stuck. I have an integrative approach to therapy, inspired by IFS, Schema, ACT, CBT and DBT, depending on the client's needs and goals. I particularly enjoy approaching therapy through a trauma-informed lens and believe a felt sense of safety, comfortability and trust in the room are essential elements for helping people to achieve lasting change.
specialties: Gender Dysphoria, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, Sexual abuse, Schema Therapy

name: Jayson Rom
title: Psychologist
description: Jayson has 19 years of experience working with both adolescents and adults presenting with a range of concerns. Particular settings that he has worked in include private practice, sexual health, the LGBTQIA+ community, forensic, drug and alcohol, and dual diagnosis mental health settings.
specialties: Diverse genders, Sex offenders, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Gender Dysphoria, Sexual abuse, Sexual difficulties

name: Brydan Xavier
title: Psychologist
description: As Director and Principal Psychologist at The Liminal Clinic, I provide clinical leadership and limited direct client work while our team delivers warm, identity-affirming, trauma-informed care for adults. We welcome all genders, sexualities, neurotypes (including autistic and ADHD people), abilities, cultures, relationship structures, and kink communities. Our psychologists support anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder, complex trauma, neurodivergence, gender and sexuality exploration, intimacy and relationships, role transitions, work/study stress, and body/eating concerns. We use EMDR 2.0, ACT, CBT, DBT, and mindfulness within flexible, strengths-based treatment.
specialties: Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual difficulties, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Sex worker issues, Diverse sexualities, Sexual abuse, EMDR

name: Isobel Youren
title: Psychologist
description: I am a person-centred psychologist who works collaboratively with clients to overcome their concerns, enhance mental wellbeing, and meet their goals. I have experience working in clinic settings, hospitals and schools, and have worked with clients of all ages, but currently work predominantly with young people and adults.

name: Rebecca Cole
title: Psychologist
description: Rebecca Cole is a Clinical Psychologist and founder of REKNDL Psychology in Richmond, Melbourne, offering in-person and telehealth sessions across Australia. Rebecca works with adults navigating trauma, anxiety, depression, eating disorders, relationship difficulties, and neurodivergence, including complex presentations. She has a special focus on neurodivergent adults and takes an affirming approach to neurodivergent experience, gender, and sexual identity. Her approach is integrative and trauma-informed, drawing on Schema Therapy, EMDR, and parts work, alongside ACT, DBT, EFT, CFT, and CBT.
specialties: Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria, Sexual abuse, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Schema Therapy, EMDR

name: Sarah Schepisi
title: Psychologist
description: Sarah is a registered Psychologist, member of the Australian Psychological Society and founder of Cloud Psychology. Sarah works collaboratively with clients, leveraging from best practice and evidence-based techniques to help support individuals aged 18+ to reach their goals and/or make change.
specialties: Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sex worker issues, Diverse sexualities, Sexual difficulties

name: Werner Briedenhann
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I'm a clinical psychologist working with men in West Melbourne. Men often arrive at therapy carrying things they've struggled to put into words- pressure, frustration, a sense of being stuck, or questions about direction that build quietly over time.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities
